description.value: You can guide your crop to move unnoticed through dangerous situations. When you and any of your crop are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Avoid Notice]{Avoiding Notice}, you can choose yourself or one member of your crop to temporarily gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Quiet Allies] skill feat until the group is no longer Avoiding Notice. The group rolls two checks instead of one, using the higher die roll.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
